title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.35.0 adds unused parameter detection with a one-click removal fix, and corrects unused import detection for $name string templates.

highlights.title: Unused Parameter Detection
highlights.description: Flags parameters that are never used (primary-constructor parameters, private constructor properties, and private function parameters) and offers a quick fix to remove them from the declaration and every call site.

highlights.title: Smarter Import Usage Detection
highlights.description: Imports referenced only inside a $name string template are no longer wrongly flagged as unused.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Adds unused parameter warnings for primary-constructor parameters, private val/var constructor properties, and private function parameters, so dead parameters are easier to spot and clean up.
Ships a quick fix that removes an unused parameter at its declaration and at every unambiguous call site, cutting out manual cleanup.
Skips override, operator, and annotated declarations, plus data classes and enums, so signatures required by frameworks or contracts are never flagged.
Enabled by default (kotlinJump.unusedParameters) and works in both the desktop extension and the web build.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Counts $name string template references as real usage of an import, alongside the existing ${…} template support, removing false positive unused import warnings.
